paired.interpretation: Paired work-component and seed bootstrap, conditional on fixed nested folds and search design. Three seeds do not exhaust initialization variance. Shared training folds are dependent; this is not a universal population guarantee.

scope: Conditional development comparison of these pipelines on source annotations. Fixed folds and three seeds are not independent blind test samples. No global architecture supremacy claim.
